patterns.title: Editorial Curtain Reveal
patterns.narrativeRole: Reveal a decisive headline and media field as one composed opening beat.

timeline.action: Render complete final content below an opaque curtain.
Reveal lines with small upward travel and stagger.
Translate curtain out while opening the media mask.
Fade proof and primary action into the settled composition.

patterns.desktopPlan: Use one full-viewport curtain and one media mask; navigation remains usable from the first painted frame.
patterns.mobileAlternative: Shorten travel, remove line-by-line delay, and reveal the CTA before the media completes.
patterns.reducedMotion: Skip curtain travel and render the complete final frame immediately with no hidden content.
patterns.noJsPlan: CSS defaults are the settled frame; an enhancement class enables the staged reveal only after initialization.

implementation.fallback: Single opacity transition on the media only.
implementation.ownershipRule: Only one timeline owns transform and clip-path for each layer.

patterns.title: Pinned Chapter Hand-off
patterns.narrativeRole: Hold one media stage while narrative chapters exchange without losing scroll position.
avoidFor: content that must be scanned rapidly

timeline.action: Show complete first chapter at pin entry.
Reduce emphasis while preserving context.
Morph or crossfade to the next proof state.
Bring the next label, claim, and proof into reading order.

patterns.desktopPlan: Pin for no more than roughly two viewports per three chapters and show useful content at pin entry.
patterns.mobileAlternative: Remove the pin; stack chapter cards with short intersection reveals and persistent media thumbnails.
patterns.reducedMotion: Render all chapters in document flow with their final proof states and no scrub dependency.
patterns.noJsPlan: Use a semantic chapter list followed by media; sticky enhancement is optional.

implementation.fallback: CSS sticky media plus non-animated chapter list.
implementation.ownershipRule: The chapter controller owns pinning; child components never create competing scroll locks.

verificationContract: capture pin entry and every hand-off

patterns.title: Kinetic Type Line Reveal
patterns.narrativeRole: Turn editorial line breaks into an intentional reading sequence.

timeline.action: Keep every line clipped by its own overflow wrapper.
Translate from 105 percent to zero.
Repeat with 70ms stagger.
Fade support copy and action without vertical travel.

patterns.desktopPlan: Lock art-directed line breaks only where the locale and viewport contract are known.
patterns.mobileAlternative: Recompute line groups after fonts load, cap the stagger, and never split individual characters by default.
patterns.reducedMotion: Remove clipping and transform; render all lines in their final positions.
patterns.noJsPlan: Headline is visible by default and wrappers are clipped only after the enhancement class is set.

implementation.fallback: Author explicit line spans in controlled marketing copy.
implementation.ownershipRule: The reveal owns line transforms; hover effects target a separate descendant.

patterns.title: Floating Image Convergence
patterns.narrativeRole: Gather spatially scattered place or product fragments into one decisive focal image.

timeline.action: Place three to five cropped fragments around a readable text core.
Move fragments toward a shared center while reducing rotation.
Expand the strongest image to the narrative focal plane.
Reveal location, object, or proof context.

patterns.desktopPlan: Use art-directed crops and avoid covering the primary reading column at every sampled state.
patterns.mobileAlternative: Use one lead image plus two small supporting images in normal flow; no convergence scrub.
patterns.reducedMotion: Render the final lead image and supporting strip without transforms.
patterns.noJsPlan: A static editorial collage remains complete and ordered.

implementation.ownershipRule: One scroll timeline owns all fragment transforms.

verificationContract: verify focal crop at each state

patterns.title: Product Object Stage
patterns.narrativeRole: Keep a product or interface object stable while nearby claims change its visible state.

timeline.action: Show the real product or interface in a credible initial state.
Introduce the first claim next to the corresponding product area.
Transition to the second real state with spatial continuity.
Reveal the measurable outcome or action path.

patterns.desktopPlan: Use a maximum of three states and keep claim-to-interface mapping unambiguous.
patterns.mobileAlternative: Place each state directly below its claim; use a swipe or short fade only when state comparison needs it.
patterns.reducedMotion: Expose all states as static labelled frames or a manually controlled tab set.
patterns.noJsPlan: Render a vertical sequence of real screenshots or product views with captions.

preferred: native video when the recording is real
implementation.ownershipRule: State changes own opacity/transform; the scroll controller only changes the active state index.

verificationContract: all claims map to visible evidence

patterns.title: Cursor Media Preview
patterns.narrativeRole: Connect an index label to its visual result without expanding every item.
avoidFor: critical navigation with no visible labels

timeline.action: Keep the preview hidden but pre-sized to prevent layout shift.
Fade and scale the selected media into the pointer-adjacent frame.
Shift emphasis to the active label without moving its hit target.
Crossfade directly to the next preview without returning to empty.

patterns.desktopPlan: Enable only for fine pointers and keep the preview away from the active label and viewport edges.
patterns.mobileAlternative: Show a thumbnail in each list row or an explicit tap-to-preview panel.
patterns.reducedMotion: Use an immediate preview swap or static thumbnails with no pointer following.
patterns.noJsPlan: Every index item includes a discoverable link and optional inline thumbnail.

implementation.ownershipRule: Pointer interpolation owns preview position; state transitions own only opacity and scale.

failureModes: media requests triggered for every movement

patterns.title: Route Curtain Transition
patterns.narrativeRole: Bridge two editorial routes while preserving fast navigation and context.

timeline.action: Keep old route readable while navigation begins.
Cover the viewport from the direction implied by navigation.
Swap routes, restore focus, and reset or preserve scroll by route policy.
Exit to reveal the already-rendered new route.

patterns.desktopPlan: Keep the total transition close to one second and never wait on non-critical media before revealing the route.
patterns.mobileAlternative: Use a shorter 240ms opacity/translate transition or native navigation.
patterns.reducedMotion: Perform immediate route replacement with focus and title announcement only.
patterns.noJsPlan: Standard links perform standard browser navigation.

implementation.ownershipRule: The route shell owns the curtain; pages cannot start competing exit timelines.

failureModes: old route remains interactive under curtain

patterns.title: Horizontal Catalog Chapter
patterns.narrativeRole: Temporarily map vertical progress to a finite lateral catalog sequence.

timeline.action: Show the first complete item and a visible sequence affordance.
Translate the finite track in direct proportion to scroll.
Update progress and contextual label at item centers.
Expose the final item completely before releasing the pin.

patterns.desktopPlan: Use a finite, labelled sequence with visible progress and no nested horizontal wheel interception.
patterns.mobileAlternative: Use native horizontal scroll with snap or a vertical list; do not pin the viewport.
patterns.reducedMotion: Expose all items in a grid or native scroll strip with manual controls.
patterns.noJsPlan: A semantic list wraps or scrolls natively.

implementation.ownershipRule: Only the track controller maps scroll; item hovers use separate descendants.

verificationContract: first and final items fully visible

patterns.title: Parallax Depth Stack
patterns.narrativeRole: Use small relative speed differences to connect layered editorial media.

timeline.action: Start with overscan sufficient for the full transform range.
Translate at roughly one-third of foreground travel.
Translate subtly in the opposing or faster direction.
Keep caption anchored to reading flow, not to decorative depth.

patterns.desktopPlan: Limit travel to a small fraction of the viewport and preserve subject crops at both extremes.
patterns.mobileAlternative: Reduce travel by at least half or use a single static crop.
patterns.reducedMotion: Disable relative movement and render the designed middle crop.

implementation.ownershipRule: Each layer has one transform owner and uses a nested element for other effects.

patterns.title: Archive Filter Morph
patterns.narrativeRole: Make a filter action visibly reorganize an editorial or product archive.

timeline.action: Announce the selected filter and busy state.
Fade items that no longer match without collapsing focus unexpectedly.
Reflow with measured layout transitions.
Announce result count and restore interaction.

patterns.desktopPlan: Preserve the user's reading anchor and keep filter controls visible while results reflow.
patterns.mobileAlternative: Use a drawer or select control; update results immediately with a short opacity transition.
patterns.reducedMotion: Swap result sets immediately and announce the new count.
patterns.noJsPlan: Use server-rendered filter links or a standard form submission.

implementation.ownershipRule: The result container owns layout transitions; item components own only hover states.

patterns.title: Image Sequence Scrub
patterns.narrativeRole: Reveal a physical transformation or product assembly in direct relation to progress.
avoidFor: assets without a meaningful state change

timeline.action: Display an optimized poster frame before sequence loading completes.
Map progress to decoded frame indices with nearest-frame fallback.
Reveal a claim only when its corresponding physical state is visible.
Hold the meaningful final state before releasing the section.

patterns.desktopPlan: Preload only a near-future window and cap canvas resolution by device and DPR budget.
patterns.mobileAlternative: Use a short compressed video or three labelled still states; never load the full sequence by default.
patterns.reducedMotion: Show the final labelled still or a manual before/after control.
patterns.noJsPlan: Poster image and explanatory content remain complete.

implementation.ownershipRule: The sequence controller owns frame selection; annotations consume state events only.

patterns.title: Data Scrollytelling Stepper
patterns.narrativeRole: Explain a data relationship by advancing one annotated state at a time.
avoidFor: data that needs free exploration first

timeline.action: Show axes, units, source, and baseline state before the first step.
Transition only the marks needed for the current explanatory claim.
Emphasize the matching annotation and de-emphasize prior context.
End in a complete summary state that can be inspected without scrolling.

patterns.desktopPlan: Keep the chart sticky and narrative steps in document flow; every state retains axes and source context.
patterns.mobileAlternative: Stack a static or lightly animated chart above each short step and allow direct step controls.
patterns.reducedMotion: Use immediate state swaps or a complete small-multiple figure.
patterns.noJsPlan: Render a table or static figure with all values and source notes.

implementation.ownershipRule: The chart state machine owns mark attributes; scroll only selects a state.

patterns.title: Cinematic Media Crossfade
patterns.narrativeRole: Move between a small number of campaign or place images without abrupt visual discontinuity.
avoidFor: essential proof that must remain visible

timeline.action: Show a complete first frame with a stable focal crop.
Decode the next asset before increasing opacity.
Crossfade with a subtle opposing scale drift.
Update caption only after the new frame becomes dominant.

patterns.desktopPlan: Use two composited layers and a pause long enough to understand each image; do not autoplay critical controls away.
patterns.mobileAlternative: Use fewer assets, smaller crops, and a longer static hold or manual carousel.
patterns.reducedMotion: Use one strongest still or immediate manual image swaps.
patterns.noJsPlan: First image and caption are fully usable.

implementation.ownershipRule: The media rotator owns opacity and scale; captions are driven by the settled index.

verificationContract: reduced motion uses static or manual state

patterns.title: Card Stack Compression
patterns.narrativeRole: Compress sequential proof cards into a visible history while the next card takes focus.

timeline.action: Show the first card completely and keep its heading visible.
Translate slightly upward and scale to a readable background state.
Enter from normal document flow without covering the prior heading.
Release all cards into a complete final arrangement.

patterns.desktopPlan: Use two or three simultaneously visible layers and keep z-index, focus, and click ownership explicit.
patterns.mobileAlternative: Use a vertical card list with small entry reveals and no overlapping interactive surfaces.
patterns.reducedMotion: Render the final vertical sequence with no scale or overlap changes.
patterns.noJsPlan: Cards appear in document order as a normal list.

implementation.ownershipRule: Stack controller owns card transforms; interactive content remains on the active card only.

patterns.title: Proof Board Focus
patterns.narrativeRole: Move focus across a credible interface or evidence board as the supporting claim changes.

timeline.action: Show the complete evidence board at readable scale.
Bring one region forward with a subtle scale or contrast change.
Reveal the claim and annotation mapped to that region.
Return to the full board before the next section.

patterns.desktopPlan: Keep the complete board understandable and use at most three focus regions with real proof.
patterns.mobileAlternative: Crop intentional subviews and place each directly beside its claim; offer the full board separately.
patterns.reducedMotion: Use labelled static crops or accessible tabs that change immediately.
patterns.noJsPlan: Display the full board with a short list of annotations.

implementation.ownershipRule: Board transforms belong to one controller; annotations never transform the same node.

sourceReferences.relationship: exploratory machine capture indicates layered fixed chrome and staged interface proof; human review remains pending

patterns.title: Immersive Footer Deceleration
patterns.narrativeRole: Create a memorable final brand beat while slowing the user into complete navigation and legal links.

timeline.action: Expose navigation and legal links before decorative motion begins.
Scale or translate the brand mark slowly into the terminal composition.
Increase link contrast and settle hover targets.
Hold a stable final frame with no loop required.

patterns.desktopPlan: Use generous scale and one slow brand motion; all links remain visible, selectable, and in normal reading order.
patterns.mobileAlternative: Stack links first and use a smaller static or short brand reveal below them.
patterns.reducedMotion: Show the settled footer immediately with no translated brand layer.
patterns.noJsPlan: Footer is a complete semantic footer with a static brand mark.

implementation.ownershipRule: Footer controller owns the brand mark only; links use independent microinteraction states.

sourceReferences.relationship: exploratory machine capture indicates cinematic media, mask reveals, and layered fixed chrome; human review remains pending

patterns.title: Spatial Canvas Camera
patterns.narrativeRole: Let the user navigate a spatial scene whose landmarks map to real content or portfolio destinations.

timeline.action: Render an accessible route/index before the canvas initializes.
Progressively initialize the lightest navigable scene.
Move with bounded acceleration and landmark snapping after explicit input.
Expose a semantic information panel tied to the selected landmark.

patterns.desktopPlan: Make controls, destination map, sound state, and escape path explicit; lazy-load the scene after core content.
patterns.mobileAlternative: Use a simplified touch scene only when tested; otherwise route to a conventional visual index.
patterns.reducedMotion: Disable camera travel and provide direct landmark selection with immediate scene cuts or static imagery.
patterns.noJsPlan: A complete semantic index links to every destination represented in the scene.

implementation.fallback: Static illustrated map or project grid.
implementation.ownershipRule: The scene state machine owns the camera; UI overlays never mutate camera transforms directly.

patterns.title: Magnetic Action Field
patterns.narrativeRole: Add a restrained attraction response to one high-value action after usability is already clear.

timeline.action: Keep the hit target stable and visually clear.
Move only the visual child a small fraction toward the pointer.
Shift icon or label by a smaller bounded amount.
Spring gently to zero on pointer exit.

patterns.desktopPlan: Apply to one primary action, cap translation tightly, and never move the actual hit area.
patterns.mobileAlternative: Use a standard pressed state with no magnetic behavior.
patterns.reducedMotion: Disable attraction and keep the normal hover/focus color or underline state.
patterns.noJsPlan: The action remains a normal semantic link or button.

implementation.ownershipRule: Pointer logic transforms a nested visual child, never the interactive element.

patterns.title: Section Color Hand-off
patterns.narrativeRole: Signal a chapter change by transferring the dominant surface color without a hard seam.
avoidFor: interfaces where surface color encodes state

timeline.action: Render the current section on a semantic color token.
Crossfade a fixed or pseudo-element color layer behind content.
Switch text tokens only after contrast is valid across the transition.
Settle on the next semantic token and release the old layer.

patterns.desktopPlan: Use one background controller and pre-validate contrast at both endpoints and the blended midpoint.
patterns.mobileAlternative: Use a shorter crossfade or hard section boundary when long scroll interpolation is unnecessary.
patterns.reducedMotion: Use immediate token changes at section boundaries.
patterns.noJsPlan: Each section has its own static background and text tokens.

implementation.ownershipRule: One page-shell controller owns the ambient surface; components consume semantic tokens.

verificationContract: contrast checked at endpoints and midpoint
